entries.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
entries.snippet: Asked about the Iranian proposal, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

entries.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
entries.snippet: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises.

entries.title: At least two dead after explosion destroys building close to Acropolis in Athens
entries.snippet: Local media report the property included a holiday rental, with US tourists and a UK national among the missing.

entries.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
entries.snippet: An emergency has been declared across the capital of Thailand as days of heavy rain leave the city inundated.

entries.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
entries.snippet: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

entries.title: Black woman found hanging from tree was dead before body was 'staged', police say
entries.snippet: Tasia Fortune's body was found hanging from a tree on the grounds of an abandoned home in Jackson in August.

entries.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
entries.snippet: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

entries.title: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
entries.snippet: CNN was scheduled to fly with US President Donald Trump for his trip to Tennessee on Saturday.

entries.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election
entries.snippet: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".

entries.title: Republic of Ireland news conference delayed before controversial Israel game
entries.snippet: The Republic of Ireland delay the pre-match news conference planned for Sunday's Uefa Nations League game against Israel in Hungary - a fixture campaigners have called on them to boycott.

entries.title: Inside the FBI hack: Agents fearful and angry after 'dangerous' data breach
entries.snippet: Current and former agents speak to the BBC about the devastating impact of the FBI hack.

entries.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial database to check voter citizenship
entries.snippet: Critics have questioned the reliability of the data, warning it could result in US citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.

entries.title: Two arrested after people seen mysteriously emerging from various New York City sewers
entries.snippet: The city has seen a string of incidents in which people have climbed out of manholes late at night.

entries.title: The treasured 'eternal snow' on this tropical island is about to disappear forever
entries.snippet: Climate change is transforming Papua's snowy peaks, which hold scientific value and spiritual significance.

entries.title: What is kratom, the 'gas station heroin' alarming officials in the US?
entries.snippet: Kratom, found during an investigation into the deaths of two college students, has been sold in the US for around a decade.

entries.title: As Merz scrambles for support, Germany's identity crisis is laid bare
entries.snippet: Voters are turning away from the centre in Germany as fears grow about the economy and migration.

entries.title: How fresh fighting in Tigray could spark wider conflict in Ethiopia
entries.snippet: Exploring the issues behind the escalation of tensions between the TPLF and the national army.

entries.title: Why an international arrest warrant didn't stop Netanyahu's US trip
entries.snippet: The BBC's Nada Tawfik explains why Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu was not arrested after speaking at the UN, despite an ICC arrest warrant.

entries.title: Bangkok declares disaster as heavy rains spark flooding
entries.snippet: Days of near continuous downpours have caused widespread flooding in the Thai capital.

entries.title: Thousands turn out to greet Pope in France
entries.snippet: The BBC's Hugh Schofield looks at why the visit is met with enthusiasm the Church attributes to growing spirituality among the French.

entries.title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran. It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.

entries.title: Meth is a key driver in Fiji's fast-growing HIV epidemic: 1 in 60 adults are affected
entries.snippet: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.

entries.title: The AI safety debate is confusing. Here's our guide to the different factions
entries.snippet: The battle over AI's promise and perils is not a clash between two opposing sides, but a debate among a range of competing voices and ideologies. Here is a guide to who's who in that debate.

entries.title: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health. Will they survive Medicaid cuts?
entries.snippet: Some states deliver meals to Medicaid patients that address their dietary needs. Evidence shows it aids recovery and saves healthcare costs, but federal budget cuts may lead some states to cancel it.

entries.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
entries.snippet: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

entries.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.

entries.title: Roads flood in New Jersey, inundate some homes, as first major signs of nor'easter take shape
entries.snippet: Thousands are without power on the U.S. East Coast, while roads are flooding in some coastal New Jersey communities.

entries.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
entries.snippet: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

entries.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
entries.snippet: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterms for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primaries.

entries.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
entries.snippet: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

entries.title: Hacks by autonomous AI agents raise thorny questions of legal accountability
entries.snippet: What happens when the hackers aren't human? That's the question at the center of a public policy debate following disclosures by leading tech companies that their AI models went rogue and hacked into other organizations.

entries.title: What the Supreme Court's voter-citizenship database decision means for the midterms
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court revived a controversial voter-citizenship database less than two months ahead of the midterm elections. In the ruling, the court sided with the Trump administration, which is seeking to use the Department of Homeland Security's SAVE database to review state vote

entries.title: Health care costs a major concern for voters ahead of midterms

entries.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump-backed Missouri congressional map for third time
entries.snippet: The justices halted a federal appeals court ruling that would have revived the Republican-friendly map for the November elections, which will determine control of Congress. There were no noted dissents.

entries.title: Wrongfully detained Iranian American journalist remains jailed in Iran after 2 years
entries.snippet: This week marks two years that Iranian American journalist Reza Valizadeh has been detained in Iran. For a decade, he worked for Radio Farda — an independent, but U.S.-funded Farsi-language news service. During a trip to Iran to visit family, Valizadeh was arrested and sentenced

entries.title: Violence has displaced more than half a million Mexican households in past 5 years
entries.snippet: Until now, Mexico's government did not share comprehensive data on people who have been forced to flee their homes due to ongoing violence in many parts of Mexico, leaving civil society groups piecing together information to get a wider view of the problem.

entries.title: GOP's big bet on Texas Latino voters could backfire in midterms
entries.snippet: Texas Republicans redrew the state's congressional map last year, making a bet that Latino voters who broke for President Trump in 2024 could be the foundation for victory in 2026. But as Liz Landers reports, immigration crackdowns and rising everyday costs in South Texas may be

entries.title: Brooks and Capehart on Trump's warm welcome for China's Xi Jinping
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join Amna Nawaz to discuss the week in politics, including Chinese President Xi Jinping's state visit, President Trump's warm welcome for the Chinese leader and Trump banning some journalists from the White House.

entries.title: Syrian dancer reflects on escaping ISIS and finding freedom through ballet
entries.snippet: Ahmad Joudeh is a ballet dancer of unusual grace and grit. He was born stateless in a Palestinian refugee camp in Damascus, Syria. He has traveled far on the power of his dreams and the elegance of his dance. He survived a traumatic childhood, much of Syria's civil war and consta

entries.title: More than 167,000 pounds of meat were recalled. What to know about the state of food safety in the U.S.
entries.snippet: More than 167,000 pounds of beef, pork and goat meat are being recalled after they were produced without the required federal inspection and labeled with a false inspection sticker, according to the Department of Agriculture.

entries.title: Trump promised to campaign in midterm battlegrounds. He's starting in deep red states instead
entries.snippet: While organizers insist the rallies are in locations with media markets that span state lines and they will help bolster broader turnout, Trump's itinerary is yet another sign of the uphill fight that his party faces.

entries.title: Mississippi police say Tasia Fortune's hanging was 'staged' after her death in a drug dispute
entries.snippet: Authorities haven't disclosed the exact cause of Fortune's death, but they did rule it a homicide and have arrested two men, both of them Black, on murder charges. They also issued an arrest warrant for a third, unnamed, person.

entries.title: New Jersey's lieutenant governor resigns after sexual harassment and ethics complaints
entries.snippet: Gov. Mikie Sherrill had given Lt. Gov. Dale Caldwell until Friday to bring an end to a scandal that threatened to be a drag on her fledgling administration.

entries.title: Report finds many security deficiencies at Utah university where Charlie Kirk was killed
entries.snippet: A new report on Charlie Kirk's assassination last year says his Turning Point USA organization insisted he speak outdoors despite security concerns, while the university where he was killed didn't properly assess dangers like the possibility of a rooftop shooter.

entries.title: Hurricane Nolo threatening Hawaii with heavy rain as Polo churns near Mexico
entries.snippet: Residents on Hawaii's Big Island were bracing Friday for potentially life-threatening and catastrophic flooding from Hurricane Nolo, while Mexico was still under the threat of Hurricane Polo as it headed toward the Baja Peninsula after bringing storm conditions to the southwester

entries.title: New Mexico jury finds Facebook liable of deceiving users about privacy protections
entries.snippet: The trial centered on accusations that Facebook deceived users about a data breach stemming from a third-party personality quiz that harvested data from roughly 87 million profiles and sold it to a political consulting firm, Cambridge Analytica, to generate targeted ads.

entries.title: Nor'easter to lash the East Coast with strong winds, flooding and heavy rain
entries.snippet: Millions of people were under warnings associated with the storm, which has already cancelled concerts and prompted people on islands near Cape Cod to head to the mainland in the days ahead of the nor'easter's arrival.

entries.title: Pope Leo XIV affirms need for media to cover public figures when asked about Trump ban
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV told journalists they were welcome to report on him, as he responded to the Trump administration's attempt to bar U.S. media from the White House and affirmed the importance of journalists covering public figures.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Paris: Pope Leo XIV to celebrate Mass before huge crowd
entries.snippet: Around 600,000 people have registered to attend a Mass at the Place de la Concorde, near the Champs-Elysees. Pope Leo XIV is on a four-day visit to France.

entries.title: A HRW report shows how South Korean women face systemic barriers to climbing the career ladder
entries.snippet: A new report shows how in South Korea, women on average earn less and have fewer employment opportunities throughout their lives.

entries.title: Deadly blast rips through Athens building, near Acropolis
entries.snippet: Several foreign tourists remain missing after an explosion brought down a building in Athens' tourist area of Plaka, with the city's mayor calling it an "incredible disaster."

entries.title: Germany news: EU ministers meet for migration showdown
entries.snippet: European interior ministers hold migration talks in Munich as the bloc plans to strengthen borders and speed up deportations. Also, will Cologne or Munich win the battle to bid for the Olympic Games? DW has more.

entries.title: India news: New Delhi, Islamabad trade accusations at UN General Assembly
entries.snippet: Shehbaz Sharif criticized India's policy on Kashmir and praised Pakistan's military, while New Delhi accused Islamabad of supporting cross-border terrorism. DW has more.

entries.title: Thailand: Bangkok flooding triggers disaster declaration
entries.snippet: Rainfall over the past three days has caused heavy flooding in the Thai capital. A state of disaster has been declared in all 50 districts in Bangkok.

entries.title: OpenAI tools post user images from ChatGPT online
entries.snippet: OpenAI said it found 53 cases in which user-uploaded image links on ChatGPT were shared with third-party websites. The company said it had removed most of these links.

entries.title: White House bars CNN from covering upcoming Trump trip, broadcaster says
entries.snippet: CNN said its journalists have been barred from accompanying President Donald Trump on his upcoming trip to Tennessee. The episode marks the Trump administration's latest salvo against the major cable news network.

entries.title: TikTok agrees to settle with Alabama state over teen safety
entries.snippet: The settlement involves TikTok adding several child safety measures to its platform including time limits and increased parental control. It is similar to a recent settlement competitor Meta had reached.

entries.title: Yemeni leader calls for general mobilization against Houthis
entries.snippet: Amid military escalation with the Iran-backed Houthis, the Saudi-backed head of Yemen's governing body urged his compatriots to join the government forces.

entries.title: Lula or Bolsonaro as president? Brazil gears up to vote
entries.snippet: Brazilians go to the polls on October 4. The front-runners are multilateralist incumbent Lula da Silva and former President Jair Bolsonaro's son, Flavio, who wants to bring Brazil closer to the US and away from China.

entries.title: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
entries.snippet: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, Germany's defense minister visited Budapest to ramp up defense and military ties.

entries.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian brought a diplomatic tone to New York for UNGA. What did his remarks signal?
entries.snippet: Iran's president used his trip to New York this week for the UN General Assembly to signal openness to talks over the nuclear dispute. However, the chances of a major breakthrough on the war remain low.

entries.title: Pakistan's Sharif rails against India, praises Trump at UNGA
entries.snippet: Pakistan's prime minister blamed India for last year's clashes, and credited the US president with preventing "all-out war" between two nuclear powers. Albania's PM told the UN delegates an anecdote about AI misuse.

entries.title: DW shows solidarity with Georgians' commitment to democracy
entries.snippet: Cultural and media professionals in Georgia remain under threat. A DW panel brings together insiders who share their hopes and fears.

entries.title: Xi wraps up US visit with trip to National Archives
entries.snippet: On the last day of his visit to the US, Chinese leader Xi Jinping visited the National Archives with President Donald Trump. The Archives store the Declaration of Independence and the US Constitution.

entries.title: AfD, CDU ban new Holocaust 'stumbling stones' in Heidenau
entries.snippet: Activists, politicians and representatives of Holocaust victims reacted with anger after the center-right CDU party joined forces with the AfD to ban new Stolpersteine (stumbling stones) in the eastern town of Heidenau.

entries.title: 'Lithuanian skies are NATO skies': DW speaks with Lithuanian premier Mindaugas Sinkevicius
entries.snippet: In a DW interview, Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius discussed threats to Lithuania from Russia and Belarus, NATO's need for stronger air defense and why military spending alone cannot ensure security.

entries.title: India news: Protests against election chief escalate as Gandhi, Cockroach party allege 'rigged' vote
entries.snippet: Police have used tear gas on protests by the opposition Congress party demanding India's election commission head steps down, following a report alleging "rigged" elections.
